caption: The drawing features two main objects on a plain, off-white background. On the left side, there is a cylindrical wooden stamp or press with a rounded handle on top. The wood texture is visible, showing natural grain patterns and a light yellow-brown color, with a slightly darker patch near the bottom front edge. The top surface of the object displays a set of concentric rings around the base of the handle. Positioned to the right of the wooden stamp is a circular, biscuit-colored imprint or medallion. This medallion features a raised design of an eagle with outstretched wings, detailed feathers on the wings and body, talons visible at the bottom, and a small star shape to the left of the eagle's head. The edge of the medallion has a notched, decorative border. Below and to the right of the medallion, there is a handwritten signature that reads "Laurence Flynn."
title: Butter Mold
